title: 第15章 得灵果
content_zh:
韩榆回到简陋的石屋，还来不及喘口气，就看到一大一小两只乌鸦如两道黑色闪电般迅速闪进屋内。

    只见那只大乌鸦稳稳地落在韩榆面前，然后微微低下它那颗乌黑发亮的头颅，一张尖锐的鸟喙轻轻张开。

    一个碧绿的枝条从其中缓缓滑落。在枝条的末端悬挂着一颗宛如宝石般璀璨夺目的蓝色果实，其大小恰似成熟的枇杷，晶莹剔透得仿佛能映出人影来。

    这颗蓝色果子周身散发着灵气，丝丝缕缕如烟似雾般萦绕在周围，同时还伴随着一股淡淡的清香味道，让人闻之心旷神怡。

    就在这时，那只稍小一些的乌鸦也学着大乌鸦的样子，同样乖巧地低下头，口中也吐出一根枝条，上面同样挂着一颗一模一样的蓝色晶莹果子。

    韩榆眼中闪过一丝惊喜之色，连忙伸手将这两颗灵果小心捧在手心里。

    “你们找到灵果了？”

    端详了一下，也不知道这是什么作用的灵果，又问：“是有主人的还是没主人？是不是宗门的药园？”

    面对韩榆的问题，大乌鸦和小乌鸦只是轻轻地晃动了几下它们的小脑袋，表示否定。

    “还有吗？”韩榆又问。

    大乌鸦和小乌鸦依然摇着头，似乎在告诉韩榆，这已经是它们所能找到的全部宝贝。

    韩榆倒是并未失望，这两个灵果就是很不错的收获，不管是什么作用，就算是不能用来自己修炼，应该也能换取一些灵米或者其他。

    “做的不错，今天我就给你们一些奖赏……”

    韩榆说着话，正要凝出血气喂养两只乌鸦，忽然感觉有些为难——刚用了四次血滴子，自身再凝出精血已经颇为困难。

    也就在这时候，大乌鸦跳到了偷灵鼠的尸体上，略带期盼地看着韩榆，发出一声渴求的轻叫。

    “嘎。”

    自从韩榆要求它们不要大张旗鼓之后，它已经不再动辄“嘎嘎”大叫。

    韩榆有点意外：“你想吃这偷灵鼠？”

    “嘎。”大乌鸦点着头轻叫。

    小乌鸦见状，也急忙跳上另一只偷灵鼠的尸体，生怕自己捞不到。

    韩榆见两只乌鸦这副模样，也是笑了：这两只偷灵鼠他本来也难以处理出手，给它们两个作为奖赏倒也不错。

    “行吧，给你们了，带走吃去吧。”
content_en:
Han Yu returned to the simple stone house. Before he could take a breath, he saw two crows, one large and one small, flashing into the house like two black lightning bolts.

The big crow landed steadily in front of Han Yu, then slightly lowered its shiny black head, and opened its sharp beak slightly.

A green branch slowly slipped from it.Hanging at the end of the branch is a blue fruit that is as bright as a gem. It is as big as a ripe loquat and is so crystal clear that it seems to reflect a human figure.

This blue fruit exudes spiritual energy, lingering around like smoke and mist. It is also accompanied by a faint fragrance, which makes people feel relaxed and happy.

At this moment, the smaller crow also imitated the big crow, lowered its head obediently, and spit out a branch from its mouth, with the same blue crystal fruit hanging on it.

A hint of surprise flashed in Han Yu's eyes, and he quickly reached out and carefully held the two spiritual fruits in his hands.

"Have you found the spiritual fruit?"

After looking at it, I didn’t know what kind of spiritual fruit it was, so I asked again: “Does it have an owner or does it have no owner? Is it the sect’s medicine garden?”

Facing Han Yu's question, the big crow and the little crow just shook their little heads slightly to express their denial.

"Is there more?" Han Yu asked again.

The big crow and the little crow still shook their heads, as if telling Han Yu that this was all the treasure they could find.

Han Yu was not disappointed. These two spiritual fruits were a very good harvest. No matter what their function was, even if they could not be used for self-cultivation, they should be able to be exchanged for some spiritual rice or other things.

"Well done, I will give you some rewards today..."

Han Yu was talking and was about to condense blood to feed the two crows when he suddenly felt a little embarrassed - he had just used blood drops four times and it was already quite difficult to condense blood himself.

At this time, the big crow jumped on the body of the spirit-stealing rat, looked at Han Yu expectantly, and let out a soft cry of longing.

"Gah."

Ever since Han Yu asked them not to make a big fuss, they no longer squawk frequently.

Han Yu was a little surprised: "Do you want to eat this spirit-stealing rat?"

"Gah." The big crow nodded and cried softly.

Seeing this, the little crow hurriedly jumped on the body of another spirit-stealing rat, for fear that he would not be able to catch it.

Han Yu also smiled when he saw the appearance of the two crows: It was difficult for him to deal with these two spirit-stealing rats, so it would be a good idea to give them two as a reward.

"Okay, here it is for you, take it away and eat it."
